subject.title: fix(memory-wiki): propagate deadline signal and skip exhaustive fallback for supplement search

question: Should memory-wiki corpus supplements intentionally return digest-only partial results under memory_search, with exhaustive body search reserved for direct wiki_search?
rationale: The patch fixes a real timeout by changing result completeness for existing users, so code inspection cannot determine the permanent recall contract without feature-owner intent.

options.title: Approve bounded supplements
options.body: Accept partial digest-only supplement results so memory_search remains within its fixed deadline.

options.title: Preserve exhaustive supplements
options.body: Require indexed, cached, or cooperatively cancellable backfill that retains existing result completeness.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded supplements
recommendation.body: Accept partial digest-only supplement results so memory_search remains within its fixed deadline.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced both affected feature layers and is the strongest history-based owner for this contract choice.
